# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't confirm the exact Binance BTC/USDT high for September, so the question isn't settled yet. Before September 26, the best-sourced intraday peak was about **$87,397-$87,400 on September 21-22, roughly $100 under the $87,500 threshold**. None of those sources ties that figure to Binance. Every direct page fetch was refused by the proxy (Binance API, Polymarket, Fortune, CryptoTimes, Forbes), so all of this comes from search-result summaries. I left out sources dated after 2026-09-26.

## 1. Resolution source
- I couldn't load the Binance BTC/USDT 1-minute chart or its API (data-api.binance.vision), so I have no reading from the actual resolution source.
- 2026-09-21/22: Bloomingbit reported Binance USDT prices of $87,013.57 at 5:23 a.m. and $86,986.60 at 5:35 a.m. on Sept 22 (KST, its local time; these are the Sept 21 evening ET readings in the next bullet). Prices were up about 7.2% on the day. These are snapshots, not the session high. [bloomingbit](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/120783), [bloomingbit](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/120785)
- 2026-09-21: Earlier Bloomingbit readings on Binance: about $83,518 at 5:38 p.m. ET and about $84,958 at 6:38 p.m. ET. [bloomingbit](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/120740)

## 2. Current status
- The question is not settled. Reports before Sept 26 put the peak near $87,400 ("near $87,000", "reclaiming $87K"). That is about 0.1% below the threshold, and Binance's USDT price can differ from USD venues by tens of dollars. Only Binance's candle data can settle whether the threshold has been touched.
- 2026-09-24: BTC was about $84,000 after briefly topping $87,000 on Sept 23 and dropping to about $83,508. At that level it needs a rise of roughly 4% to reach $87,500. [usethebitcoin](https://usethebitcoin.com/bitcoin/bitcoin-price-september-24-2026/)
- Window left after forecasts close: from 2026-09-26 07:05 UTC to 2026-09-30 23:59 ET, about 4.7 days.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Week ending 2026-09-25: Spot BTC ETFs took in about $2.4B, the most in a week since October 2025 (from a live tracker page, so possibly stale). [MetaMask](https://metamask.io/price/bitcoin)
- 2026-09-24: A "$87K rejection" report puts overhead supply at $86,000-$89,000. [usethebitcoin](https://usethebitcoin.com/bitcoin/bitcoin-price-september-24-2026/)
- 2026-09-24: BTC hit $87,000 for the first time since January. Reports cite about $2B in ETF inflows and a short squeeze. [CryptoTimes](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/09/24/bitcoin-price-hits-87000-for-first-time-since-january-can-the-rally-hold-into-year-end-2/), [CryptoTimes](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/09/24/inside-bitcoins-september-2026-rally-btc-reclaiming-87k-2b-in-etf-inflows-and-a-short-squeeze/)
- 2026-09-23: BTC was about $86,406. Analysts said a close above $87,400 could open a path toward $90,000. [99bitcoins](https://99bitcoins.com/news/presales/bitcoin-price-analysis-september-23-2026)
- 2026-09-22: Forbes reported a "fresh multimonth high near $87,000". The same day, more than 13,800 BTC left Binance. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/digital-assets/2026/09/22/bitcoin-extends-gains-to-hit-fresh-multimonth-high-near-87000/), [Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/market-updates/binance-sees-13800-btc-exit-bitcoin-price-holds-above-83k/)
- 2026-09-21: BTC rose about 17% in six days, from below $75,000 (low around Sept 15-16) to over $87,000. Drivers cited were more than $800M in short liquidations and about $1B in ETF buying. This came after the CLARITY Act failed in the Senate (Sept 15) and the Fed raised rates 25bp (Sept 16). [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/bitcoin-climbed-below-75-000-122234605.html), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/bitcoin-surges-past-87-000-140707613.html)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-09-01: September opened at about $78,155 (Fortune) to $78,563. BTC had gained about 28% in August. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-09-01-2026/), [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Moma/which-price-will-bitcoin-hit-in-sep)
- Volatility this month: the range so far is about $74,900 to $87,400, a 17% swing in six days. Ordinary daily moves of 3-7% have been common, for example +5.5% and +7.2% days around Sept 21. [bloomingbit](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/120740)
- A rough benchmark: with BTC's 30-day implied volatility around 45-55% a year, a 4-5 day window works out to about a ±5-6% one-sigma move. That would put a touch of +4% from about $84K well within ordinary variation. This is my own arithmetic, not a sourced figure.
- The $87,000-$87,400 level has turned BTC back at least twice (Sept 21-22 and Sept 23).

  - A PredScope snapshot from about Sept 1 had ↑$87,500 at 28%. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-in-september-2026)
- 2026-09-21: Robinhood's market for the Sept 22, 2 p.m. EDT price priced "$87,400 or above" at 2¢. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/crypto/events/btc-price-on-sep-22-2026-at-2pm-edt-sep-21-2026/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Sept 26-30: weekend trading, then quarter-end and monthly options/futures expiry (usually the last Friday, so likely Sept 25). Quarter-end rebalancing could add volatility.
- ETF flow prints each day; the run of large inflows is the main upside driver.
- US macro data releases in the final week (for example PCE, usually late in the month; I couldn't confirm the date).
- Liquidation clusters near $87K on Binance could trigger a quick spike through $87,500 if the price retests that level.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

# Bitcoin reaching $87,500 on Binance in September 2026: research notes (cutoff 2026-09-26)

Bitcoin came within about $100 of the $87,500 line on September 21 and has since fallen back to around $84,000. I could not confirm the exact Binance high, which is the number that decides the question. Several pages I needed would not load through the proxy, so some figures below come from search-result summaries rather than the full articles.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding data is the highest 1-minute candle on Binance BTC/USDT between Sep 1 and Sep 30 (ET). I could not open the Binance chart, and I found no source dated before the cutoff that gives the exact Binance BTC/USDT high for the month.
- 2026-09-22: Bloomingbit reported BTC trading at $87,013.57 on Binance's USDT market early that day, near the peak but not the peak itself. [Bloomingbit](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/120783)
- Most reports say the September peak was $87,397 on Sep 21 (likely a Coinbase or composite price). Pluang gives a slightly lower intraday high of $87,374. Binance BTC/USDT usually trades within a few tens of dollars of USD prices, sometimes above and sometimes below. That gap matters here, because the peak was only about $100 to $125 short of the threshold. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/09/26/bitcoin-hit-an-eight-month-high-above-87000-on-september-21-and-is-back-under-85000-was-that-the-weeks-top-or-the-quarters/), [Pluang](https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/harga-bitcoin-melonjak-ke-87ribu-dolar-dan-level-90ribu-kembali-dibahas)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The highest reported September print, about $87,397, is below $87,500, but I could not confirm the Binance 1-minute high directly. Checking Binance's Sep 21 candles is the key verification step.
- 2026-09-26: BTC is reported back under $85,000 after the Sep 21 peak. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/09/26/bitcoin-hit-an-eight-month-high-above-87000-on-september-21-and-is-back-under-85000-was-that-the-weeks-top-or-the-quarters/)
- 2026-09-25: BTC was reported at about $84,171. [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/bitcoin-ethereum-options-q3-2026-expiry/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-26: 24/7 Wall St asks whether the $87K level on Sep 21 (an eight-month high) was "the week's top or the quarter's." [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/09/26/bitcoin-hit-an-eight-month-high-above-87000-on-september-21-and-is-back-under-85000-was-that-the-weeks-top-or-the-quarters/)
- 2026-09-25: About $16.6B in BTC and ETH options expired on Deribit for Q3, about $14.6B of it BTC. BTC put/call ratio was 0.52, and the estimated max-pain level was $72K to $75K. [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/bitcoin-ethereum-options-q3-2026-expiry/)
- 2026-09-24: CryptoTimes describes the rally as BTC retaking $87K on about $2B in ETF inflows plus a short squeeze. [CryptoTimes](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/09/24/inside-bitcoins-september-2026-rally-btc-reclaiming-87k-2b-in-etf-inflows-and-a-short-squeeze/)
- 2026-09-23: Fortune's daily snapshot put BTC at about $85,686. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-09-23-2026/)
- 2026-09-22: Forbes reported a fresh multi-month high near $87,000. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/digital-assets/2026/09/22/bitcoin-extends-gains-to-hit-fresh-multimonth-high-near-87000/)
- 2026-09-21: BTC peaked at about $87,397, its highest since January. Reports cite about $715M in one-day ETF inflows and about $750M in short liquidations. Crypto Briefing noted liquidation clusters on Binance stacked around $87K. [Pluang](https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/harga-bitcoin-melonjak-ke-87ribu-dolar-dan-level-90ribu-kembali-dibahas), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/binance-bitcoin-liquidation-clusters-87k/)
- 2026-09-18: CoinDesk said BTC was "weathering" the rate hikes and a setback for the Clarity Act, trading around $78K. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/09/18/bitcoin-weathers-september-storm-as-rate-hikes-and-clarity-act-setback-test-bulls)
- 2026-09-16 to 17: The Fed raised rates by 25bp, its first hike in more than three years. BTC dipped toward $75K, then held. [UseTheBitcoin](https://usethebitcoin.com/bitcoin/bitcoin-price-september-17-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- September path so far: about $78.2K on Sep 1 ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-09-01-2026/)), about $77K on Sep 13 ([UseTheBitcoin](https://usethebitcoin.com/bitcoin/bitcoin-price-september-13-2026/)), a dip toward $75K around Sep 16 to 17, a peak of about $87.4K on Sep 21, about $84.2K on Sep 25. That is roughly a 16% range within the month.
- To resolve Yes from about $84K to $85K, BTC would need to rise about 3% to 4% within roughly 4.5 days (Sep 26 through Sep 30 ET). In 2025 and 2026, BTC's maximum upside move over a 4 to 5 day window has often been in that 3% to 5% range. Over the past week it has fallen, not risen. This is a rough estimate from typical volatility; I did not compute it from data.
- The $87K to $87.4K area was the local top, and short liquidations cleared it once. That makes it a visible resistance level.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket or Kalshi price for this specific monthly $87,500 market dated before the cutoff.
- A Manifold market with this exact title and Binance 1-minute criteria exists, but I found no pre-cutoff probability for it. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Jack1/bitcoin-87500-in-september-2026)
- PredScope lists Polymarket's "What price will Bitcoin hit on September 26?" daily market. Nearby strikes were priced at about 1% to 9%, on thin volume (about $25K). [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-on-september-26-2026)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Sep 26 to 27: weekend trading, which usually has thinner liquidity.
- Sep 26 to 30: daily US spot ETF flow reports. Inflows drove the Sep 21 spike.
- Sep 30: month-end and quarter-end (Q3) close, which can bring rebalancing flows. The quarterly options expiry (Sep 25) has already passed.
- Late September: possible US macro data and Fed speakers after the Sep 16 hike. I did not find a specific scheduled release.
- Ongoing: news on the Clarity Act in the Senate.
